## Load libraries

```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lemon)
library(Rmisc)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
```

## House-style constants

```{r house-style}
# PNAS final-size artwork: Figure 5 is exported directly at full width.
FONT_FAMILY    <- "Helvetica"
FONT_SIZE_PT   <- 7
FONT_SIZE_GEOM <- FONT_SIZE_PT / .pt
TAG_SIZE_PT    <- 7.5
GG_LINE_UNIT_PT  <- 0.75 * 72.27 / 25.4
pt_to_ggline     <- function(x) x / GG_LINE_UNIT_PT
SECONDARY_LINE_PT <- 0.25
AXIS_LINE_PT      <- 0.50
PRIMARY_LINE_PT   <- 0.75
LINE_SIZE       <- pt_to_ggline(SECONDARY_LINE_PT)
ERROR_LINE_SIZE <- pt_to_ggline(AXIS_LINE_PT)
AXIS_LINE_SIZE  <- pt_to_ggline(AXIS_LINE_PT)
DATA_LINE_SIZE  <- pt_to_ggline(PRIMARY_LINE_PT)
TICK_LENGTH_PT <- 2.5
POINT_SIZE     <- 1.8
POINT_STROKE   <- 0.53
INTERVAL_HIGHLIGHT_FILL <- "#EBEBEB"
FIGURE_WIDTH_IN  <- 7
FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN <- 3.111111

ACCURACY_LIMITS <- c(0, 100)
ACCURACY_BREAKS <- seq(0, 100, 20)
SUMMARY_ACCURACY_LIMITS <- c(40, 100)
SUMMARY_ACCURACY_BREAKS <- seq(40, 100, 20)

GROUP_COLORS <- c(
  "AI" = "#0173B2",
  "AI Human" = "#029E73",
  "Human" = "#DE8F05"
)

GROUP_LABELS <- c(
  "AI" = "AI",
  "AI Human" = "AI + Human",
  "Human" = "Human"
)

GROUP_SHAPES <- c(
  "AI" = 21,
  "AI Human" = 22,
  "Human" = 24
)

theme_figure5 <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_family = FONT_FAMILY, base_size = FONT_SIZE_PT) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = FONT_FAMILY, size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = "#000000", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE),
      axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "#000000", linewidth = AXIS_LINE_SIZE),
      axis.ticks.length = grid::unit(TICK_LENGTH_PT, "pt"),
      axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 3)),
      axis.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      plot.title = element_text(
        face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = FONT_SIZE_PT,
        margin = margin(t = 7, b = 1)
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5, size = FONT_SIZE_PT,
        margin = margin(b = 3)
      ),
      legend.title = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.background = element_blank(),
      legend.key.width = grid::unit(6, "pt"),
      legend.key.height = grid::unit(7, "pt"),
      legend.spacing.y = grid::unit(0.5, "pt"),
      legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = FONT_SIZE_PT),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
    )
}
```

## Load utilities and data

```{r load-utilities-and-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("plot_util_test.R")

data_raw <- read_excel(
  "../Study_2_FollowUp_Results/MAR/data/Study_2_Full_Data.xlsx"
)
data_filtered <- data_raw[data_raw$stage1_task0_accuracy < 0.9, ]
```

## Panel a: Task accuracy across phases

```{r panel-a-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data_filtered1 <- data_filtered[, c(
  "Label",
  "stage1_task0_accuracy",
  "stage2_task0_accuracy",
  "stage3_task0_accuracy",
  "follow_task0_accuracy"
)]

data_filtered2 <- data_filtered1[!is.na(data_filtered1$follow_task0_accuracy), ]

df_11 <- data_preprocessing(
  data = data_filtered1,
  label_col = c(
    "Label",
    "stage1_task0_accuracy",
    "stage2_task0_accuracy",
    "stage3_task0_accuracy",
    "follow_task0_accuracy"
  ),
  new_columns_name = c("Label", "Stage1", "Stage2", "Stage3", "Follow"),
  data_columns = c("Stage1", "Stage2", "Stage3", "Follow"),
  one_names_values = "Phase",
  one_values_values = "Accuracy",
  after_columns_name = c(
    "Stage 1: Independent work",
    "Stage 2: LLM-guided practice",
    "Stage 3: LLM-provided answers",
    "Follow-up"
  ),
  phase_subtitle_name = c(
    "Independent \n work",
    "LLM-guided \n practice",
    "LLM-provided \n answers",
    ""
  ),
  phase_short_name = c("Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Stage 3", "Follow-up"),
  groupby_col = "Label"
)

df_11_plot <- df_11$stats_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Phase_short = factor(
      Phase_short,
      levels = c("Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Stage 3", "Follow-up")
    ),
    Label = factor(Label, levels = c("AI", "AI Human", "Human")),
    x_plot = as.numeric(Phase_short),
    mean_pct = mean * 100,
    ci_pct = ci95 * 100
  )
```

```{r panel-a-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fig11 <- ggplot(df_11_plot, aes(x = x_plot, y = mean_pct)) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = 1,
    xmax = 2,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = INTERVAL_HIGHLIGHT_FILL,
    colour = NA
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 50,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey55",
    linewidth = LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 3.5,
    colour = "grey55",
    linewidth = LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_pct - ci_pct,
      ymax = mean_pct + ci_pct,
      colour = Label
    ),
    linewidth = ERROR_LINE_SIZE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = Label, colour = Label),
    linewidth = DATA_LINE_SIZE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Label, colour = Label, shape = Label),
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    stroke = POINT_STROKE
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 3.58,
    y = 52,
    label = "Chance",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 0,
    family = FONT_FAMILY,
    size = FONT_SIZE_GEOM
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 3.58,
    y = 96,
    label = "1-month\ndelay",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    family = FONT_FAMILY,
    size = FONT_SIZE_GEOM
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = GROUP_COLORS,
    labels = GROUP_LABELS,
    name = "Label"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = GROUP_COLORS,
    labels = GROUP_LABELS,
    name = "Label"
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = GROUP_SHAPES,
    labels = GROUP_LABELS,
    name = "Label"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.85, 4.25),
    breaks = 1:4,
    labels = c(
      "Stage 1",
      "Stage 2",
      "Stage 3",
      "Follow-up\n "
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = SUMMARY_ACCURACY_LIMITS,
    breaks = SUMMARY_ACCURACY_BREAKS,
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  coord_capped_cart(bottom = "both", left = "both", gap = 0.01) +
  labs(
    tag = "A",
    title = "Accuracy across phases",
    subtitle = NULL,
    x = NULL,
    y = "Accuracy (%)"
  ) +
  theme_figure5() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.05, 0.98),
    legend.justification = c("left", "top"),
    plot.margin = margin(4, 8, 4, 4),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.955)
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      title = "Label",
      title.position = "top",
      title.hjust = 0,
      override.aes = list(
        linewidth = 0,
        linetype = 0,
        fill = unname(GROUP_COLORS),
        colour = unname(GROUP_COLORS),
        shape = unname(GROUP_SHAPES),
        size = POINT_SIZE,
        stroke = POINT_STROKE
      )
    ),
    fill = "none",
    shape = "none"
  )
```

## Panel b: Attrition sensitivity test

```{r panel-b-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_12_1 <- data_preprocessing(
  data = data_filtered2,
  label_col = c(
    "stage1_task0_accuracy",
    "stage2_task0_accuracy",
    "stage3_task0_accuracy"
  ),
  new_columns_name = c("Stage1", "Stage2", "Stage3"),
  data_columns = c("Stage1", "Stage2", "Stage3"),
  one_names_values = "Phase",
  one_values_values = "Accuracy",
  after_columns_name = c(
    "Stage 1: Independent work",
    "Stage 2: LLM-guided practice",
    "Stage 3: LLM-provided answers"
  ),
  phase_subtitle_name = c(
    "Independent \n work",
    "LLM-guided \n practice",
    "LLM-provided \n answers"
  ),
  phase_short_name = c("Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Stage 3"),
  groupby_col = NULL
)

df_12_2 <- data_preprocessing(
  data = data_filtered,
  label_col = c(
    "stage1_task0_accuracy",
    "stage2_task0_accuracy",
    "stage3_task0_accuracy"
  ),
  new_columns_name = c("Stage1", "Stage2", "Stage3"),
  data_columns = c("Stage1", "Stage2", "Stage3"),
  one_names_values = "Phase",
  one_values_values = "Accuracy",
  after_columns_name = c(
    "Stage 1: Independent work",
    "Stage 2: LLM-guided practice",
    "Stage 3: LLM-provided answers"
  ),
  phase_subtitle_name = c(
    "Independent \n work",
    "LLM-guided \n practice",
    "LLM-provided \n answers"
  ),
  phase_short_name = c("Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Stage 3"),
  groupby_col = NULL
)

df_12_1_plot <- df_12_1$stats_summary
df_12_2_plot <- df_12_2$stats_summary
df_12_1_plot$Label <- "Follow-up completers"
df_12_2_plot$Label <- "All participants"

df_combined <- bind_rows(df_12_1_plot, df_12_2_plot) %>%
  mutate(
    Phase_short = factor(
      Phase_short,
      levels = c("Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Stage 3")
    ),
    Label = factor(
      Label,
      levels = c("Follow-up completers", "All participants")
    ),
    x_plot = as.numeric(Phase_short),
    mean_pct = mean * 100,
    ci_pct = ci95 * 100
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(x_plot))
```

```{r panel-b-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
attrition_labels <- c(
  "Follow-up completers<br>(<i>n</i> = 84)",
  "All participants<br>(<i>n</i> = 175)"
)

fig12 <- ggplot(df_combined, aes(x = x_plot, y = mean_pct)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 50,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey55",
    linewidth = LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = mean_pct - ci_pct, ymax = mean_pct + ci_pct),
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = ERROR_LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = Label, linetype = Label),
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = DATA_LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(shape = Label, fill = Label),
    colour = "black",
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    stroke = POINT_STROKE
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    values = c("All participants" = 21, "Follow-up completers" = 21),
    labels = attrition_labels,
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("All participants" = "black", "Follow-up completers" = "white"),
    labels = attrition_labels,
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("All participants" = "solid", "Follow-up completers" = "dashed"),
    labels = attrition_labels,
    name = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.85, 3.15),
    breaks = 1:3,
    labels = c("Stage 1", "Stage 2", "Stage 3"),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = SUMMARY_ACCURACY_LIMITS,
    breaks = SUMMARY_ACCURACY_BREAKS,
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  coord_capped_cart(bottom = "both", left = "both", gap = 0.01) +

    tag = NULL,
    title = "Attrition sensitivity test",

    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_figure5() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.05, 0.98),
    legend.justification = c("left", "top"),
    legend.text = ggtext::element_markdown(hjust = 0, lineheight = 0.95),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(13, "pt"),
    legend.key.spacing.y = grid::unit(4, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(4, 10, 4, 2),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.03, 0.955)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 2,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 21,
        size = POINT_SIZE,
        stroke = POINT_STROKE
      )
    ),
    shape = "none",
    linetype = "none"
  )
```

## Panel c: Early- versus late-corrected items

```{r panel-c-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_correction <- read_csv("data/Correction_Data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
correction_contrasts <- read_csv(
  "data/Correction_Timing_Contrasts.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

p_values <- correction_contrasts %>%
  transmute(
    Label,
    label_text = if_else(
      p.value < 0.001,
      "italic(P)~'< 0.001'",
      paste0("italic(P)~'= ", sprintf("%.3f", p.value), "'")
    )
  )

morey_sum <- summarySEwithin(
  data = df_correction,
  measurevar = "Measure",
  withinvars = "Group",
  betweenvars = "Label",
  idvar = "ID",
  na.rm = TRUE,
  conf.interval = 0.95
)
```

```{r panel-c-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fig13 <- ggplot(df_correction, aes(x = Group, y = Measure)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 50,
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = "grey55",
    linewidth = LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(group = ID),
    colour = "grey82",
    alpha = 0.65,
    linewidth = LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = morey_sum,
    aes(x = Group, y = Measure, group = 1, colour = Label),
    linewidth = DATA_LINE_SIZE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    data = morey_sum,
    aes(
      x = Group,
      y = Measure,
      ymin = Measure - ci,
      ymax = Measure + ci,
      colour = Label
    ),
    linewidth = ERROR_LINE_SIZE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = morey_sum,
    aes(x = Group, y = Measure, colour = Label, fill = Label, shape = Label),
    size = POINT_SIZE,
    stroke = POINT_STROKE,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = p_values,
    aes(x = 1.5, y = 96, label = label_text),
    family = FONT_FAMILY,
    size = FONT_SIZE_GEOM,
    parse = TRUE,
    colour = "black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~Label, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    "AI" = GROUP_COLORS[["AI"]],
    "AI + Human" = GROUP_COLORS[["AI Human"]],
    "Human" = GROUP_COLORS[["Human"]]
  )) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "AI" = GROUP_COLORS[["AI"]],
    "AI + Human" = GROUP_COLORS[["AI Human"]],
    "Human" = GROUP_COLORS[["Human"]]
  )) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(
    "AI" = 21,
    "AI + Human" = 22,
    "Human" = 24
  )) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("Early-corrected" = "Early", "Late-corrected" = "Late"),
    expand = expansion(add = 0.22)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = ACCURACY_LIMITS,
    breaks = ACCURACY_BREAKS,
    labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = 0)
  ) +
  coord_capped_cart(bottom = "both", left = "both", gap = 0.01) +
  labs(
    tag = "B",
    title = "Follow-up accuracy for early- (Stage 2)",
    subtitle = "versus late-corrected (Stage 3) items",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_figure5() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(4, "pt"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.tag.position = c(0.02, 0.955)
  )
```

## Combine and export

```{r combine-and-export, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
combined_core <- fig11 + fig12 + fig13 +
  plot_layout(nrow = 1, widths = c(0.42, 0.28, 0.45)) &
  theme(
    plot.tag = element_text(size = TAG_SIZE_PT, face = "bold")
  )

BRACKET_COLOR <- "grey55"
SAMPLE_SIZE_LABEL_Y <- 0.040
BRACKET_Y <- SAMPLE_SIZE_LABEL_Y
STAGE_1_X <- 0.0788
STAGE_3_X <- 0.2521
FOLLOW_UP_X <- 0.3370
STAGE_GROUP_CENTER_X <- (STAGE_1_X + STAGE_3_X) / 2
BRACKET_TEXT_GAP <- 0.031
STAGE_GROUP_N_Y <- SAMPLE_SIZE_LABEL_Y
FOLLOW_UP_N_Y <- SAMPLE_SIZE_LABEL_Y

combined_figure <- ggdraw(combined_core) +
  draw_line(
    x = c(STAGE_1_X, STAGE_GROUP_CENTER_X - BRACKET_TEXT_GAP),
    y = c(BRACKET_Y, BRACKET_Y),
    colour = BRACKET_COLOR,
    size = LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  draw_line(
    x = c(STAGE_GROUP_CENTER_X + BRACKET_TEXT_GAP, STAGE_3_X),
    y = c(BRACKET_Y, BRACKET_Y),
    colour = BRACKET_COLOR,
    size = LINE_SIZE
  ) +
  draw_label(
    expression(italic(n) == 175),
    x = STAGE_GROUP_CENTER_X,
    y = STAGE_GROUP_N_Y,
    fontfamily = FONT_FAMILY,
    size = FONT_SIZE_PT,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  draw_label(
    expression(italic(n) == 84),
    x = FOLLOW_UP_X,
    y = FOLLOW_UP_N_Y,
    fontfamily = FONT_FAMILY,
    size = FONT_SIZE_PT,
    colour = "black"
  )

combined_figure

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study2_1.pdf",
  combined_figure,
  width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN,
  height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  family = FONT_FAMILY,
  symbolfamily = FONT_FAMILY,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study2_1.png",
  combined_figure,
  width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN,
  height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  "figure/Figure_Study2_1.svg",
  combined_figure,
  width = FIGURE_WIDTH_IN,
  height = FIGURE_HEIGHT_IN,
  bg = "white"
)
```
